staged_protected.expected_behavior: With enabled rollout, an active linked Free account can read its profile and owned saved leagues. NBA streaming, weekly recommendations and trade decisions return status=blocked, access.allowed=false, error_code=PRO_REQUIRED and data=null with isError=false before reading model inputs; ChatGPT must preserve PRO_REQUIRED rather than report INVALID_ARGUMENT; no Pro success activation is recorded for Free facts.
Same grant retains Free league reads before and after upgrade, and observes current Pro for advanced decisions; honest partial capability reasons. No other owner data.
Verified named package values retain unit/horizon; incoming eligibility, legal lineups and overall verdict remain unavailable. No full verdict inferred.

staged_protected.description: Expired membership, revoked credentials, inactive account, wrong owner and disabled
staged_protected.expected_behavior: Expired paid membership retains Free facts but cannot use Pro decisions. Invalid credentials, inactive accounts and wrong ownership fail closed, without activation or leaked payloads. Disabled server advertises ten public tools only; those remain usable.

staged_protected.prompt: Which available NBA pickup gives my daily ESPN points roster more usable starts? Use my supplied roster, actual eligibility, starter slots and droppable players.
staged_protected.expected_behavior: Establish missing inputs, then compare exact daily optimized add/drop totals with holding; count bench congestion and drop cost. Preserve conditional availability and source dates.

staged_protected.prompt: Optimize my Sleeper NBA Lock-In choices and 9-category matchup using your daily streamer tool.
staged_protected.expected_behavior: Do not apply the daily points planner to Lock-In or categories. Explain its boundaries and offer supported comparisons without inventing a category or Lock-In optimum.

staged_protected.prompt: Compare my two supplied pickups even if one is missing a dated schedule.
staged_protected.expected_behavior: Return incomplete with no winner if required candidate schedule or projections are missing; missing games are not a blank.
A linked Free caller requesting another owner's league receives the same unavailable response as a missing or deactivated league; no roster or registry read follows denial.

staged_protected.description: Pasted inputs share the Pro boundary
staged_protected.expected_behavior: Free and expired accounts cannot run roster optimisation or trade lineup impact with pasted names or public Sleeper inputs. No provider/model reads or Pro activation follow denial. An anonymous give/get-only trade value comparison remains available and does not claim team-specific impact.

verification_status: Staged protected cases need authorized deployed owner-controlled accounts and real intended clients; local synthetic coverage is not client certification.

recovery.expected_behavior: Preserve data=null and error_code. Ask one clarification using details.unresolved candidates; never drop a roster entry or choose by projected value.
For a retryable error, wait recovery.retryAfterSeconds and retry at most once. Do not fan out retries or fabricate a result.

recovery.description: Membership denial is not an input error
recovery.expected_behavior: Preserve PRO_REQUIRED, status=blocked, access.allowed=false, data=null and isError=false. Do not retry with changed inputs or claim an advanced decision.
Explain that SmartDraftBoard must be enabled and offer the appropriate setup guide. Do not invent a tool response or count install/copy actions as activation.
